item.title: What is influenza B, the type of flu now on the rise?
item.description: The number of people getting sick with influenza B has gone up for three weeks straight, now making up about a third of flu cases nationwide.

item.title: Curling controversy widens as Britain is accused of the same infraction as Canada
item.description: Three curling teams – two Canadian, one British – have been accused of the same infraction: double-touching the curling stone.

item.description: PORTLAND, Ore.
